content:
Everyone has noticed: Vinicius Jr is below this season. And on the side of the Spanish capital, he is clearly the Madrid player most criticized by the media and supporters. And on social networks, a conspiracy theory has taken shape in recent days, to the point where it is even relayed by newspapers like Marca.

She simply explains that Vinicius Jr was in reality abducted – possibly by aliens – and that the player currently playing is a double, who replaces him to continue to receive the money from his contracts. The theory is based in particular on certain physical differences between the Vinicius Jr of last seasons and that of this season, such as the disappearance of certain tattoos. As the Spanish media logically indicates, the player’s entourage and Real Madrid pay no attention to this type of rumor.
